description.p: Vesper is a native, beautiful Discord client for Linux built with GTK 4. It offers a familiar server, channel and message layout with a powerful TOML-based theme engine, including translucent themes for compositors with blur support.
Note: Vesper is an unofficial client that logs into a regular Discord user account. Using third-party clients can violate Discord's Terms of Service; use it at your own risk.
Initial release: gateway and REST session, webview and token login, theme engine with hot reload, and the core app shell.
